entities.name: Hugh de Kevelioc, 5th Earl of Chester
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Hugh of Cyfeiliog, 5th Earl of Chester, also written Hugh de Kevelioc or Hugh de Kevilioc, was an Anglo-Norman magnate who was active in England, Wales, Ireland and France during the reign of King Henry II of England.
